title: Hajj journey map
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y5 lesson 19 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Hajj journey map)
intro: Lesson 19: The rites of Hajj in order, and the best ten days. To understand the main rites of Hajj in order and how Muslims everywhere share in the first ten days of Dhul-Hijjah

questions.q: Put in order: Arafah, ihram, tawaf, sa'i.
questions.model: Teacher: 'First the pilgrim enters ihram, then tawaf around the Ka'bah, then sa'i between Safa and Marwah, then on the ninth day Arafah.'

questions.q: Make a 'Hajj journey map' on the pupil PDF: number the places (Ka'bah, Safa and Marwah, Mina, Arafah) in order and write one sentence for each.
questions.a: Correct order with a sentence on what happens at each place
questions.model: Teacher writes stop 1: 'The Ka'bah: pilgrims make tawaf, walking around it seven times.'

questions.q: list three good deeds you can do in the ten days even though you are not on Hajj.
questions.a: Takbir, fasting Arafah, sadaqah, extra salah, helping at home

questions.q: why do pilgrims all wear simple ihram clothes?
questions.a: To show equality and humility before Allah
